    Controlled vocabulary for open-access statuses

    Source: R/vocab.R
    sm_oa_statuses.Rd

    Canonical values for works$oa_status. All levels except closed are open; missing and unrecognised values are unknown. Status definitions follow the OpenAlex taxonomy (see the link below), with open for access without a known colour. When an export names several statuses, the package uses the first recognised level in the order below: diamond, gold, hybrid, bronze, green, open, closed.

    sm_corpus() and sm_corpus_from_tables() normalise common spellings with a message. Consumers also recognise those spellings in saved corpora. The column remains character, and unknown strings are kept as written.

    Usage

    sm_oa_statuses(describe = FALSE)

    Arguments

    describe

    Logical; if TRUE, return a tibble with a factor level, logical is_open and character description; otherwise the character vector of statuses in precedence order.

    Value

    A character vector or a tibble of status descriptions.

    See also

    sm_audit_oa(), sm_filter_works(), https://help.openalex.org/data/works/open-access/

    Other corpus: as_sm_corpus(), is_sm_corpus(), sm_bind_corpora(), sm_build_corpus(), sm_concept_vocabularies(), sm_corpus(), sm_corpus_from_tables(), sm_dedupe(), sm_link_references(), sm_materialise(), sm_save_corpus(), sm_validate(), validate_sm_corpus()

    Examples

    sm_oa_statuses()
#> [1] "diamond" "gold"    "hybrid"  "bronze"  "green"   "open"    "closed" 
sm_oa_statuses(describe = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 7 × 3
#>   level   is_open description                                                   
#>   <fct>   <lgl>   <chr>                                                         
#> 1 diamond TRUE    Fully open-access journal without article processing charges. 
#> 2 gold    TRUE    Fully open-access journal.                                    
#> 3 hybrid  TRUE    Openly licensed article in a subscription journal.            
#> 4 bronze  TRUE    Publisher-hosted free text without an identified open licence.
#> 5 green   TRUE    Repository-hosted free copy of an otherwise restricted work.  
#> 6 open    TRUE    Open access with no known colour.                             
#> 7 closed  FALSE   No known open-access copy.
